name: Carriage
summary: Old horse-drawn coach in side view with four wheels, windows, a door and lanterns; no horse. For period scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the wheels stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 800 px wide and 600 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels turn and the coach rocks (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the shafts point left

author: krakujs
